title: Posters and Conference Talks That People Actually Remember

hook.en: At a conference, people walk past a poster in about ten seconds, and a talk is forgotten by lunch unless it has one clear idea. A poster is an advertisement for your work, and a talk is a conversation with a room. Learn to design both for a tired, busy human being.
hook.ur: Conference mein log poster ke saamne se takreeban das second mein guzar jate hain, aur talk dopahar tak bhula di jati hai jab tak us mein ek saaf khayal na ho. Poster aap ke kaam ka ishtihaar hai, aur talk ek kamray se baat cheet. Dono ko thake, masroof insaan ke liye design karna seekhein.

goal.en: By the end, you'll structure a poster around three messages, design it for reading from two metres, plan a 10-minute talk with one idea per slide, rehearse it, and handle questions calmly.
goal.ur: End tak aap poster ko teen paighamat par tarteeb denge, do meter se parhne ke liye design karenge, ek slide ek khayal ke saath 10 minute ki talk plan karenge, mashq karenge, aur sawalon ko pur-sukoon sambhalenge.

text.en: A good poster answers three questions at a glance: **what was the question, what did you find, and why does it matter?** Use a clear title, a few short blocks, big figures and very little text. A good talk has **one main message**, a story (problem, what you did, what you found, what it means) and clear slides. In both, say the main message in one sentence a stranger can repeat.
text.ur: Achha poster ek nazar mein teen sawalon ka jawab deta hai: **sawal kya tha, aap ne kya paya, aur kyun ahem hai?** Saaf title, chand chhote hissay, bade figures aur bohat kam text istemal karein. Achhi talk mein **ek asal paigham**, ek kahani (masla, aap ne kya kiya, kya paya, is ka kya matlab) aur saaf slides hoti hain. Dono mein asal paigham ek aise jumle mein kahein jo ajnabi dohra sake.

text.en: Think of **a roadside signboard**. A driver has three seconds, so the sign has one message in big letters and a picture, not a paragraph. A poster is that signboard for your study, and a talk is the conversation when the driver stops for tea.
text.ur: **Sadak kinare ka signboard** sochein. Driver ke paas teen second hote hain, isliye signboard par bade harf aur ek tasveer ke saath ek paigham hota hai, paragraph nahi. Poster aap ke study ka woh signboard hai, aur talk woh baat cheet hai jab driver chai ke liye rukta hai.

rows.en: About 2 metres, 10 seconds to catch attention
rows.ur: Takreeban 2 meter, tawajjo pakadne ke 10 second

rows.en: The audience listens for the whole slot, but forgets fast
rows.ur: Sunne wale poora waqt sunte hain, lekin jaldi bhoolte hain

rows.en: Under about 300 words; short bullet points
rows.ur: Takreeban 300 alfaaz se kam; chhote bullet points

rows.en: A few words per slide; you tell the story aloud
rows.ur: Har slide par chand alfaaz; kahani aap zabani sunate hain

rows.en: Big, simple, with a one-line "so what" under each
rows.ur: Bade, saade, har ek ke neeche ek line ka "phir kya"

rows.en: One figure per slide, with a clear title that states the finding
rows.ur: Ek slide par ek figure, saaf title jo nateeja batata ho

rows.en: Visitors ask questions at their own pace; give a 30-second pitch
rows.ur: Dekhne walay apni raftar se sawal poochhte hain; 30 second ki pitch dein

rows.en: Questions at the end, in front of everyone, so prepare for them
rows.ur: Sawal aakhir mein sabhi ke saamne, isliye tayyari karein

title.en: Build a talk in four steps

steps.title: Write the one-sentence message
steps.detail: For example, "A six-week home exercise programme reduces knee pain more than advice alone." Everything must serve it. || Ek jumle ka paigham likhein

steps.title: Plan the story
steps.detail: Problem (1 slide), what you did (1 to 2), what you found (2 to 3), what it means and limits (1 to 2). Roughly one slide per minute, so about 8 to 10 slides for 10 minutes. || Kahani ka plan banayein

steps.title: Design simple slides
steps.detail: One idea per slide, a title that states the point, large text (at least 24 points), a big figure and no paragraphs. Read nothing from the slide. || Saade slides banayein

steps.title: Rehearse aloud, with a timer
steps.detail: Practise at least three times, ideally in front of a colleague. Finish under time, and prepare answers to the three hardest questions. || Waqt ki ghari ke saath zor se mashq karein

question.en: A poster has 900 words in small print and one tiny graph. What is the best fix?
question.ur: Poster mein chhote harfon mein 900 alfaaz aur ek chhota graph hai. Behtareen hal kya hai?

text.en: Shrink the font to fit it all
text.ur: Sab fit karne ke liye font chhota karein

text.en: Cut the text by two-thirds, use short bullets, and make one clear figure big enough to read from two metres
text.ur: Text do tihai kam karein, chhote bullets istemal karein, aur ek saaf figure itna bara karein ke do meter se parha ja sake

feedback.en: Yes — a poster is an advertisement, not a paper pinned on a board.
feedback.ur: Haan — poster ishtihaar hai, board par laga hua paper nahi.

text.en: Add more text so nothing is missed
text.ur: Mazeed text jorein taake kuch na chhoote

feedback.ur: Zyada text parhne walon ko khota hai.

question.en: What should the title of a results slide say?
question.ur: Nateejon ki slide ka title kya kehna chahiye?

feedback.ur: Yeh sunne walon ko kuch nahi batata.

text.en: The finding itself, for example "Pain fell by 12 points more with exercise"
text.ur: Khud nateeja, masalan "Exercise se dard 12 point zyada kam hua"

feedback.en: Yes — an informative title tells the audience what to look for.
feedback.ur: Haan — maloomati title sunne walon ko batata hai kya dekhna hai.

question.en: You have 10 minutes. How many slides is a sensible plan?
question.ur: Aap ke paas 10 minute hain. Kitni slides ka plan munasib hai?

feedback.en: It would be read, not heard.
feedback.ur: Yeh parhi jayegi, suni nahi jayegi.
Sunne wale pichhe nahi chal payenge.

text.en: About 8 to 10, with one idea each, and time left for the end
text.ur: Takreeban 8 se 10, ek ek khayal ke saath, aur aakhir ke liye waqt bacha kar

feedback.en: Yes — about one minute per slide is a good rule of thumb.
feedback.ur: Haan — takreeban ek minute per slide achha andaaza hai.

text.en: **Putting the whole paper on the slide or poster.** If you read it out, the audience reads faster than you speak and stops listening. Keep only what supports the one message. Another trap is running over time: practise with a timer and cut slides, not speed. And never hide limitations; say them calmly, which builds trust.
text.ur: **Poora paper slide ya poster par daal dena.** Agar aap isay parh kar sunayen to sunne wale aap se tez parhte hain aur sunna chhor dete hain. Sirf woh rakhein jo ek paigham ki himayat kare. Ek aur jaal waqt se zyada chalna hai: ghari ke saath mashq karein aur raftar nahi, slides kam karein. Aur hadein kabhi na chhupayein; unhein pur-sukoon bayan karna bharosa banata hai.

text.en: **Prepare a 30-second pitch and a QR code.** Stand beside your poster and say the one-sentence message, then "ask me about..." Put a QR code to the full paper or a handout so people can follow up. For nerves, breathe out slowly, speak a little slower than normal, and remember that most of the audience wants you to do well.
text.ur: **30 second ki pitch aur QR code taiyar rakhein.** Apne poster ke paas khade ho kar ek jumle ka paigham kahein, phir "mujh se poochhein..." Poore paper ya handout ka QR code lagayein taake log rabta kar saken. Ghabrahat ke liye aahista saans bahar nikalein, aam se thora dheere bolein, aur yaad rakhein ke zyada tar sunne wale chahte hain ke aap achha karein.

question.en: Why do conference audiences remember so little?
question.ur: Conference mein sunne wale itna kam yaad kyun rakhte hain?

answer.en: People hear dozens of talks and see hundreds of posters, so attention and memory are limited. We remember a clear story, one surprising number or one picture far better than a list of methods. The best presenters decide in advance what the audience should remember in a week, and design everything around that.
answer.ur: Log darjanon talks sunte aur saikron posters dekhte hain, isliye tawajjo aur yaadasht mehdood hoti hain. Hum saaf kahani, ek hairat angez number ya ek tasveer ko methods ki fehrist se kahin behtar yaad rakhte hain. Behtareen presenters pehle se tay karte hain ke sunne wale ek haftay baad kya yaad rakhein, aur sab kuch usi ke gird design karte hain.

beats.patient: A student presents her pilot trial of text reminders. Her first draft slide deck has 25 slides with tables of statistics, and she plans to read them. A colleague listens and says she cannot tell what the main finding is.
beats.assessment: The message is buried in details.
beats.treatment: She writes the one-sentence message, cuts to 9 slides with one idea each, replaces tables with one figure showing exercise completion, and practises three times with a timer.
beats.reassess: Her talk finishes at 9 minutes 40 seconds, the audience asks good questions, and a clinic asks to try her reminders.

text.en: **Protect patients when you present.** Remove names, faces, dates and any details that could identify a person, and use only pictures you have written consent to show. Do not show a clinical technique as safe or proven beyond what your study found. Declare funding and conflicts of interest on the poster or the first slide.
text.ur: **Presentation mein mareezon ko mehfooz rakhein.** Naam, chehre, tareekhein aur woh tafseelat jo kisi ki pehchan karwa sakein hata dein, aur sirf woh tasveerein dikhayein jin ke liye likhi razamandi ho. Kisi clinical technique ko us se zyada mehfooz ya sabit na dikhayein jitna aap ke study ne paya. Funding aur mufaadat ke takrao poster ya pehli slide par batayein.

text.en: Hess, Tosney and Liegel's AMEE guide on effective poster presentations recommends a short, informative title, a clear visual hierarchy, limited text, large readable figures and a layout that guides the eye, so that the main message can be taken in at a glance. Alley's work on scientific presentations promotes slides whose titles are full-sentence assertions of the main point with supporting visuals, rather than topic labels followed by bullet lists, because this helps audiences follow and remember the message.
text.ur: Hess, Tosney aur Liegel ki AMEE guide mu'assir poster presentations ke liye mukhtasar, maloomati title, saaf visual tarteeb, mehdood text, bade parhne ke qabil figures aur aisa layout tajweez karti hai jo nazar ko rehnumai de, taake asal paigham ek nazar mein samajh aa jaye. Alley ka science presentations par kaam aisi slides ko farogh deta hai jin ke title asal nukte ka mukammal jumle ka bayan hon aur saath madadgar visuals hon, na ke mauzu ke label ke baad bullets ki fehrist, kyunke yeh sunne walon ko paigham samajhne aur yaad rakhne mein madad deta hai.

text.en: **One message, Big figure, Few words, Practise.** One message, a big figure, few words and practise aloud with a timer.
text.ur: **Ek paigham, Bara figure, Kam alfaaz, Mashq.** Ek paigham, bara figure, kam alfaaz aur ghari ke saath zor se mashq.

summary.en: Build a poster or talk around one message, with a big figure and very few words.
summary.ur: Poster ya talk ek paigham ke gird banayein, bade figure aur bohat kam alfaaz ke saath.

summary.en: Plan about one slide per minute, make titles state the finding, and practise aloud with a timer.
summary.ur: Takreeban ek slide per minute plan karein, titles ko nateeja batane wala banayein, aur ghari ke saath zor se mashq karein.

summary.en: Protect patients' identity, declare conflicts and state limits calmly.
summary.ur: Mareezon ki pehchan mehfooz rakhein, mufaadat ke takrao batayein aur hadein pur-sukoon bayan karein.

front.en: How long does a poster have to catch attention?
front.ur: Poster ke paas tawajjo pakadne ke liye kitna waqt hota hai?

front.en: What should a results-slide title say?
front.ur: Nateejon ki slide ka title kya kahe?

back.en: The finding itself, in a sentence.

front.en: How many slides for a 10-minute talk?
front.ur: 10 minute ki talk ke liye kitni slides?

back.en: The one-sentence message plus an invitation to ask questions.
back.ur: Ek jumle ka paigham aur sawal poochhne ki dawat.

note.en: The story your poster and talk summarise.
note.ur: Woh kahani jis ka poster aur talk khulasa hain.
